title: Robert M NDE 1038
content:
Admitted to the emergency room with chest pain. Treated with clot busting medicine for blockage in vessel feeding the bottom of my heart determined by electrocardiograph. After ninety minutes, I said to the doctor, 'Boy, do I feel dizzy!' I immediately blacked out, and I felt like I sank through the bottom of the stretcher into water. I had the feeling I was flailing my arms to swim back to the surface. I was panicking, fighting for my life (while arguing with myself to let go). Suddenly I am standing twenty feet away from the stretcher watching the doctor perform CPR on my body. During his time, I was very calm, and noticed I was only a consciousness, no body, no pain, no problems, no worries. It was great! As I watched the doctor perform compressions on my chest I thought, I don't feel anything, this guy can't control whether I live or die. I thought only I can control whether live or die. As soon as I had this thought I was back in my body, and awake.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing about twenty feet away from the stretcher watching the doctor perform CPR on his body.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt like he sank through the bottom of the stretcher into water; flailing arms to swim back to the surface; panicking/fighting for his life while arguing with himself to let go.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Returned immediately after thinking that only he could control whether he lived or died.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Sinking sensation 'through the bottom of the stretcher into water' and struggling to swim back to the surface before the OBE.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackout and sinking/struggling sensation followed by an out-of-body observation of CPR, then immediate return upon a thought.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Felt like sinking through the bottom of the stretcher into water and flailing arms to swim back to the surface; return triggered by the thought that only he could control whether he lived or died.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Boy, do I feel dizzy!"; "I was only a consciousness, no body, no pain, no problems, no worries."; "I thought only I can control whether live or die."
